task: O8 -- the schema-3 IO captures analysed jointly with the FA7/O2 linear observation model across commitments that share a data plane
model_provenance: the message/terminal/proximity model, its exact Fp2 and rank algebra and its included/excluded observation classes are Claude Fable 5.1's FA7 work (scripts/zk60_fable_joint_capture.py, scripts/zk60_fable_joint_rank.py), imported unchanged. The schema-2 repaired parser and layout arithmetic are Opus 5's O2 work (scripts/zk60_opus_repaired_capture.py), also imported unchanged. New in O8: the schema-3 parser, the recomputed IO layout, and JointModel -- the same model over a union of commitments with one proximity block per commitment and a data-plane alias.

round20_opening_lemma.statement: at fixed claim points, group lambdas and proximity challenges, any message difference that already satisfies the individual terminal, public-row, shared-endpoint-plane and zero-sum conditions can be absorbed by each owner's independent pads so that every group and proximity vector and every sampled encoded word stay unchanged simultaneously, bijectively on the pad space; the same holds for the eight-slot M opening and its two blinders
exclusions: fixed challenges only: it does not treat witness-dependent Fiat-Shamir challenges as independent fixed inputs, so adaptive composition stays open
one opening only: repeated openings are excluded, and its own negative tests show one blinder translation generally cannot preserve two different M weightings
the salted Merkle roots and authentication paths are NOT held fixed; a translation of field observations is not a forged receipt and not a simulator
the new endpoint roots are caller-fixed public inputs; the endpoint preparation / auxiliary-input model and its commitment/transcript simulation remain unspecified
CFS round messages are outside it
round20_opening_lemma.depends_on_this_task: the lemma supplies no message difference and proves no condition satisfiable; O8 must establish the joint message result, and independent per-role checks do not establish it

included_observation_classes.group_vectors: every message coordinate v_g[j], j < n, of every group vector (2 base rows each)
included_observation_classes.proximity_vector: every coordinate prox[j], j < n, of EVERY commitment's proximity vector (2 base rows each); each proximity vector combines all rows of its own commitment
included_observation_classes.terminals: every claim value (2 base rows each), including the H sum claim's public value 0
included_observation_classes.zero_sum: H only: the public constraint sum_j u[j] = 0 on the zero-sum mask row pair (2 base rows), proven by the zsum sumcheck
included_observation_classes.aliasing: one unknown per (row, column): rows opened by several claims are the same unknowns
included_observation_classes.cross_commitment_alias: A rows 14/15 (X) and 16/17 (z16) are the SAME unknowns as rows 0/1 of the input and the output endpoint; the masks of the two commitments stay distinct unknowns

excluded_observation_classes.pads: the Q pad coordinates v_g[n..n+Q) of every clear vector: linear in the Q fresh pad unknowns of each row, not in the message unknowns (FA2 section 14.6 argument; not modelled)
excluded_observation_classes.sampled_columns: the Q opened encoded columns (values, salts, paths): (f_row + Z_n g_pad) at coset points, hidden by the pads (Vandermonde) and the salted leaves (hash assumption); not modelled
excluded_observation_classes.cfs: the CFS mask commitment and the masked sumcheck round messages / claimed sums: nonlinear in the data; FA6
excluded_observation_classes.repeats: repeated proofs of the same witness (fresh challenges each): FA8; every capture is analysed alone
excluded_observation_classes.unopened_columns: the Merkle root over unopened columns: computational hiding assumption, outside a linear model
excluded_observation_classes.adaptive_composition: the transcript derives every public coefficient AFTER masked messages are absorbed; the model conditions on the captured coefficients as fixed, so adaptive dependence is outside it (FA7's standing exclusion, restated because the IO profile adds two more adaptive rounds)
excluded_observation_classes.endpoint_second_encoding: NEW with this profile: each aliased data plane is encoded and column-opened TWICE, once inside A and once inside its endpoint commitment, at independently sampled column sets; the encoded-column hiding argument must now cover two encodings of one plane

structure_validated_only.pads: width and count only (every role clear vector has n + Q = 512 entries, the M vectors 1024); the pad VALUES stay outside the linear model
structure_validated_only.sampled_columns: count, index range, per-column width, salt width and Merkle path length only (256 columns of 11 nodes per role commitment, 256 columns of 20 words and 12 nodes for M); the column VALUES stay outside the model
structure_validated_only.cfs: the M commitment's slot schedule, its fourteen public functionals' term shapes and widths, and the two IO / six FFN sumchecks' round and terminal counts; every VALUE in them stays outside the model
structure_validated_only.endpoint_policy: the 112-byte policy is parsed and bound to the endpoint roots; the context and scales are public inputs, not modelled observations

combination_requirements.imported_from: soundness of the IO equality sumcheck
combination_requirements.how: the linear observations cannot themselves prove that A's X slice and the input endpoint's first 512 values are the same numbers. combination_requirements.requirement: the masks of the two commitments stay separate unknowns

combination_requirements.requirement: one block coordinate pair per proximity vector
combination_requirements.how: the inherited RoleModel carries exactly ONE proximity vector because it models one commitment. Merging three commitments needs three, kept separate: summing them would model an adversary who sees only their sum, which is weaker than what is published. This is the ONE implementation generalisation; the observation classes and the algebra are unchanged, and JointModel on a single commitment reproduces RoleModel exactly (control controls.joint_model_matches_role_model).

combination_requirements.requirement: one cross-column coordinate space for all terminals
combination_requirements.how: every claim terminal of every merged commitment plus H's public zero-sum constraint live in one cross-column space, so a functional may mix them.

verdict.note: disclosed dimensions of base-field data unknowns that survive mask elimination, in the linear model with the stated exclusions; H's residual is its public LogUp identity. No privacy theorem, no U-2 closure.

limits: A linear-model rank result on four proof-of-concept captures, under the captured (fixed) public coefficients. It is not a simulator, not a conditioning argument, and not an upper bound on disclosure.
The joint result imports the A <-> endpoint plane equality from the SOUNDNESS of the IO sumcheck; the linear observations do not establish it. The unaliased union is reported as a control.

Excluded by construction and unchanged from FA7/O2: pad coordinates, sampled encoded columns, the CFS mask commitment and every masked sumcheck round message, repeated proofs of one witness, the Merkle root over unopened columns, and adaptive transcript composition. The capture now CONTAINS these observations; containing them is not analysing them.
NEW and unresolved: each aliased plane is encoded and column-opened twice, in A and in its endpoint. That is outside the linear model and has no argument yet.

Codex's round-20 opening lemma covers the pad / encoded-column / M-opening channel CONDITIONALLY and consumes this result as its premise. Nothing here folds that channel into the model, and neither the adaptive composition nor the caller-fixed endpoint root simulation is accepted; the lemma keeps no Merkle root or authentication path fixed.

This is NOT whole-protocol zero knowledge and U-2 is NOT closed. It covers only ffn-v3-mr1-fresh-io-poc/2 at T32/d16/f16, function 1, fresh per-proof weights: no registered model identity, no function 2, no attention, no stable-weight profile, no transport envelope.
The captures hold no witness values; nothing here is compared to a ground truth.
No private-block, deployment or throughput acceptance follows.
